note: Election of one councillor for each of the five wards (retirement in rotation), polled on Monday 16 May 1938. Nominations closed on 5 May; the retiring members in Central, Curran, Inver and Townparks were the only persons nominated, and only Gardenmore was contested. Only person nominated; retiring member. Returned unopposed.
